card.statement: If $\mathbf{k}$ is an algebraic closure of a finite field, then the dimension of $\widetilde{G}_{\mathbf{k}}$ is at most the dimension of the reductive $\mathbf{k}$ -group with root datum dual to that of $G$ (i.e.  $\dim(G)$ ).
card.label: Lemma 14.4

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
